metadata.title: Isometry Groups of Right Invariant Metrics in Geometric Quantum Complexity
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we give a complete description for the full isometry groups of a class of right invariant Riemannian metrics on the special unitary group $\mathrm{SU}(2^N)$. These metrics have been used by physicists to study Nielsen's geometric approach for complexities in quantum computations.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对量子计算几何复杂度中使用的一类 SU(2^N) 右不变黎曼度量，作者给出完整等距群的描述。
analysis.breakthrough: 把 Nielsen 几何复杂度中所用特定度量的全部对称性明确化。
